text: @whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab 是面向 DSH Web 的文件改动审查插件，在聊天完成行展示本轮文件差异，并提供 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签查看会话内各轮改动。它从工具调用与会话快照整理文件路径和行级差异，支持查看红绿差异、按文件或轮次撤销与重做，并可从聊天入口跳转到侧栏展开对应文件。适合需要检查 agent 生成或修改文件的 DSH Web 用户。使用前需要安装兼容的 DSH Web 与 dsh-better-sidebar。

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab adds file review to DSH Web chat and the dsh-better-sidebar. It shows per-turn and session file changes with line diffs, and supports undo, redo, and links from chat to expanded sidebar files. For users reviewing agent edits; requires DSH Web and dsh-better-sidebar.

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · 与上游的差异：| 项 | 上游 `dsh-file-review-tab@0.5.0` | 本 fork `@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab@0.7.1` |

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · 与上游的差异：**不要同时安装两者**：两个包注册同一个 `turnTail` 槽位与同一个 `ui-deliverables` 补丁（都会禁用内置 ui-deliverables 行），共装会出现重复卡片。

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · 功能：- **对话尾部审查行（与原生同款外观）**：回合结束出现「已编辑 N 个文件 +M −K」卡片，其外观**逐像素对齐 DSH 内置的 ui-deliverables 改动卡片**——同一个 60px 头部、40px 文件类型图标块、13px 标题、悬停时 `+N −K` 让位给「在侧边栏预览」、等宽字体文件行、超过 4 行折叠为「全部 N 个文件」，并同样复用官方的 `FileTypeIcon` / `HoverCard` / 折叠箭头。差异只有一处：**头部右上角多出「撤销（撤销后可点「重新应用」）与「审查」两个按钮**——内置卡片标题栏没有任何插槽，所以本插件自渲染同款卡片以容纳这两个按钮。鼠标悬停 500ms 即弹出该文件的 diff 预览；点「审查」或单个文件名，**深链打开侧边栏 Tab，自动展开对应文件的 diff 并定位到该轮分组顶部**（不再弹全宽 drawer）。
- **侧边栏 Tab「文件审查」**：按轮次分组列出本会话改动文件；点击展开行级红绿 diff；支持撤销本轮 / 单文件撤销 / 重新应用；Tab 角标实时显示改动文件数。表头是与原生同款的 38px 对照条（文件选择器 + 统计），工具行提供「分栏 / 换行 / 刷新」三个可切换/可用的控件，每个都带 500ms 提示气泡。
- **删除文件可见**：dsh 没有删除文件的工具，删除发生在终端命令里——插件解析 `rm` 族命令（`rm` / `rmdir` / `unlink` / `shred` / `trash` / `Remove-Item` / `del` / `rd` / `erase` 等）的字面路径参数，被删文件以「已删除」标记出现在两个入口（内容已不存在，故无行级 diff、不可撤销）。带通配符（`rm *.log`）或命令替换（`rm $(...)`）的删除不识别——受影响文件事后无法枚举。
- **自动归档**：主列表只保留最近 5 轮（进行中的轮次永不归档），更早的已完成轮次沉入底部「已归档 N 轮」折叠区。折叠时归档内容零渲染，展开后每页加载 10 轮（「加载更多」续页），diff 行另有懒挂载——长会话不再一次性挂载几十个 diff 组。深链跳到已归档轮次会自动展开并定位；展开状态按会话记忆；角标只统计主列表。
- **PTC / Code Mode 支持**：`run_code` 程序内部的 `edit`/`write` 子调用也会被捕获——Host 端快照完整 before/after，浏览器端重建带行号的行级 hunks 并入所属轮次；diff 查看、状态检查、撤销/重做均可用。标准模式行为不变（对话尾部审查行仍只覆盖标准模式轮次）。
- **会话隔离**

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Differences from upstream：Relative to upstream `main` (`1de22fc`, `0.5.0`), this fork differs in two ways: DSH 0.2.0 adaptation, and this fork's own publishing decision.

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Differences from upstream：| | Upstream `dsh-file-review-tab@0.5.0` | This fork `@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab@0.7.1` |
|---|---|---|
| Target DSH | 0.1.5 | **0.2.0-rc.2** |
| Typert codecs | legacy `schema:` shape (0.2.0 rejects it at registration) | strict `TypertCodec.create()` factories |
| Turn-tail slot | `turnTail` chain (`select` + `priority`, first claim wins) | `turnTail` **additive list** (`id` + `order`, entries coexist) |
| Turn-tail card | custom card | **native ui-deliverables look** + undo/review buttons |
| Sidebar tab header | custom | native 38px comparison bar + split/wrap/refresh tools (500ms tooltips) |
| Auto-archive | none | newest 5 turns inline; older turns fold into a paged section (10/page) |
| Deleted files | not surfaced | literal `rm`-family paths marked "deleted" |
| Code Mode (PTC) | none | `run_code` sub-calls recorded into their owning turn |
| npm name | `dsh-file-review-tab` | **`@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab`** (bare name held by upstream) |

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Differences from upstream：**Do not install both.** Each registers the same `turnTail` slot and disables the built-in `ui-deliverables` row, so installing both yields a duplicated card.

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Features (English)：- Chat turn-tail review row that mirrors the built-in ui-deliverables changes card (same 60px header, file-type tile, hover preview, 4-row fold with "All N files") and adds the two buttons the built-in header cannot host: undo/reapply and review. It deep-links into the sidebar tab (auto-expanding the diffs and scrolling the turn group to the top) instead of a full-width drawer.
- Sidebar tab "File Review" in dsh-better-sidebar: per-turn grouped changed files, line-level red/green diffs, undo per turn or per file, live badge with the changed-file count. Its header is the native 38px comparison bar (file selector + counts) with a split / wrap / refresh tool row, each control carrying a 500ms tooltip.
- Deleted files stay visible: dsh has no delete-file tool, so deletions happen in terminal commands — literal `rm`-family arguments (`rm`, `rmdir`, `unlink`, `shred`, `trash`, `Remove-Item`, `del`, `rd`, `erase`, …) are parsed and deleted files appear marked "deleted" in both surfaces (no line diff, no undo: the content is gone). Glob/command-substitution deletions are not guessed.
- Auto-archive: only the newest 5 turns stay in

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Features (English)：Requires DeepSeek Harness web (0.2.0-rc.2+, verified on 0.2.0-rc.2) and dsh-better-sidebar (≥ 0.19.1, verified on 0.24.1), the latter installed separately. Install this fork from npm (`dsh plugin --profile web add @whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab`) or from this repo's GitHub source (`dsh plugin --profile web add github:whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab`). `0.7.x` targets the DSH 0.2.0 client API (strict `TypertCodec.create()`, additive `turnTail` list slot, native-identical changes card) and is this fork's only npm release; the bare name `dsh-file-review-tab` on npm belongs to upstream and is still `0.5.0` for DSH 0.1.5, so installing the bare name does not get this fork's version. Users on DSH 0.1.5 should stay on upstream `0.5.x`, and DSH 0.1.2 / 0.1.1 on `0.4.1`. Restart `dsh web` after installing, then open the "File Review" tab from the sidebar's "+" menu. If a freshly published version is held back by pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` (24 h default), pin it exactly: `@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab@0.7.1`.

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Development：`pnpm test` drives the built artifacts through the real DSH 0.2.0 registries rather than mocking them, so a breaking upstream API change fails here instead of in the UI. Several checks read `lib/`, so `test` runs `build` first as a `pretest` step: without it a `src/` edit could pass every check against the previous build. All fourteen checks assert behavior no typecheck can see:

@whybebabo/dsh-file-review-tab README · Development：- `test/typert-descriptors.mjs` — registers the Host Typert contribution against the real registry and round-trips every codec (plus a control proving the pre-0.2.0 `schema:` codec shape is rejected).
- `test/slot-registration.mjs` — registers the turn-tail entry against the real `SlotCore` (a list slot requires an `id`).
- `test/host-apply.mjs` — runs the host half's `apply()` on a real cordis `Context` and drives the `tools/post-execute` recorder plus the `fileReview` Remote service.
- `test/undo-redo.mjs` — drives the real `fileReview` service against a temp workspace and asserts an exact undo→redo round trip for multi-hunk and multi-mutation files, including a payload whose settlements arrive in the wrong array order.
- `test/interleaved-mutations.mjs` — a turn whose changes arrive through BOTH channels (a `run_code` mutation recorded by the Host, plus a model-direct `edit`) stays in event order, so undo and redo both still round-trip; a deletion and a later recreation resolve by event order too (a recreated file is not left marked deleted); and the `recorded` fetch re-arm signal plus its throttle pacing are verified.
- `test/
